M4 (right-click menus, branch claude/m4-context-menus) will make small, separate edits in your files. main.rs: one 'mod context_menu;' line, one Msg::ContextMenu variant, one Request::LeaveRoom variant, one App field (+ its init in App::new), one update() arm, one line at the top of the Escape chain, and a Shift+F10 / Menu key arm in the keyboard subscription. view.rs: wrap the message row (the hover::row(...) call in conversation()), the sender avatar+name in the group header, channel_row's button and the root view() with a context-menu area; message_tools() returns None while a menu is open. I won't touch message body rendering (your rich text). engine/mod.rs: one Command::LeaveRoom variant + its dispatch arm (the leave function itself goes in engine/rooms.rs). engine/app.rs: one engine_done arm for Request::LeaveRoom. Logic lives in new files src/autocomplete.rs, src/pills.rs, src/emoji.rs, src/engine/compose.rs, src/view/autocomplete.rs, src/view/emoji_picker.rs.

For your user menu's Mention: M2 adds App::mention(user_id) -> Task<Msg> in rust-client/src/autocomplete.rs (branch claude/m2-autocomplete). It inserts '@Name ' at the composer cursor as a real pill (sent with m.mentions + matrix.to link) and focuses the composer, so a menu item can just 'return self.mention(&user)'.
